description:
Map ALL relationships of a model on the live database - both directions: the model's own
    relational fields (many2one/one2many/many2many + their comodels/inverse) AND every OTHER model
    that points BACK at this one. This is the 'all links' view for understanding how a model wires
    into the schema before you extend it. READ-ONLY.

    Returns outgoing[] (field, type, comodel, inverse/table) and incoming[] (model, field, type).
name: odoo_db_relations
